rationale.edition: Every changed path sits in the openobserve (OSS) repo: src/ crates (api/management, builtins, config/meta, db, infra/table, core/traces/otel, jobs), web/src/components/settings, web/src/services, and locale files. No o2_enterprise/ or enterprise/ paths are touched. However, the model pricing module is an enterprise-gated feature: its E2E spec model-pricing.spec.js exists only in the enterprise E2E overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json 'append' -> Management) and not in the OSS/cloud matrix, it is grouped alongside the known enterprise settings cipherKeys and logoManagement, and model pricing is the GenAI cost-tracking capability tied to enterprise gen_ai config. So the change is an enterprise-gated module implemented in OSS code -> edition enterprise.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. There is no explicit opt-out (no tests-added label; trigger_comment.txt is empty) and the change is user-facing. The diff touches no docs-only or CI-only files; the changed .spec.ts files under web/src are Vitest unit tests, not a reason to skip. Continue to E2E.
rationale.e2e: The change adds a real user-facing UI flow in the settings > model pricing editor: per-tier attribute rules (key/operator/values rows with add/remove controls), a tier priority input, ambiguous and unreachable tier warning banners, rule rendering in the pricing list drawer, and a test-model-match dialog that now accepts span attribute rows. These interactions and their validation states need browser-level verification.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI changes live in web/src/components/settings/ (ModelPricingEditor, ModelPricingList, TestModelMatchDialog). Sibling E2E specs for settings/management live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Management/ (the Management shard), so this belongs in the Management area.
rationale.group: model-pricing.spec.js is already appended to the Management shard in ci_matrix.ent.json (actual_folder Management), so the new attribute-rules spec joins the same Management playwright group rather than spawning a new shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff — tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ is untouched. The only changed test files are Vitest unit specs (web/src/components/settings/*.spec.ts and web/src/utils/formatters.spec.ts), which are unit coverage, not E2E coverage. No E2E specs in the diff.
